services.desc: Want to fly like a bird? There’s no better feeling than soaring amongst eagles and hawks. Our sponsor companies on this page are private organizations that provide lessons and tandem flights. They are all run by members in good standing with the West Coast Soaring Club, and as such, they are certified HPAC Instructors. This also means they carry HPAC insurance. Our sponsors operate independently from the West Coast Soaring Club. We are not responsible for any arrangement, services, or goods you may obtain from them.
